question: What was the year-over-year percentage growth in total crimes?

WITH yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        "YEAR"::INT AS "YEAR",
        COUNT(*) AS total_crimes
    FROM crime_incidents
    GROUP BY "YEAR"
)
SELECT
    yc."YEAR",
    ROUND(100.0 * (yc.total_crimes - LAG(yc.total_crimes) OVER (ORDER BY yc."YEAR")) 
          / NULLIF(LAG(yc.total_crimes) OVER (ORDER BY yc."YEAR"), 0), 2) AS "YOY_GROWTH_PERCENT"
FROM yearly_counts yc
